items.question: Which sacred sites are located in the northwest and north directions?
premises: Jālandhara is assigned to the northwest direction.
Kolāpūra is assigned to the north direction.
The verse continues the directional placement of sacred sites.
items.inference: Jālandhara occupies the northwest, while Kolāpūra occupies the north.
uncertainties: The grammatical case of the site names is taken as accusative in form but functions as a locative designation in this listing.
items.plain_english: Jālandhara is in the northwest, and Kolāpūra is in the north.
